decisions.text: TypeScript/Node for services and Lambdas — one language across services, Lambdas and shared domain package.
Terraform for IaC (owner choice).
Cognito issues user and service (client_credentials) tokens; auth POST /validate verifies them centrally.
No password stored by us — Cognito owns credentials; auth_identity is a sub→auth_id mapping.
POC in af-south-1, single env, right-sized (1 NAT, 1 task/service, Aurora Serverless v2 min ACU).
user → account → card hierarchy; GET /cards is s2s-only; GET /me returns accounts with masked cards.
auth_identity stores user_id (logical) so /validate returns userId in one hop, beating an auth→users call per validation.

SUPERSEDED (partly superseded by ADR-016 (no auto-rules)). Dispute window 120 days from posted_at; 7 reason codes; resolution by auto-rules Lambda and back-office internal API; never auto-reject, never auto-accept FRAUD.
SES email on every dispute status change; notifier fetches email by userId so events carry no PII.
SUPERSEDED (superseded by ADR-023 (no outbox)). Outbox relay sends directly to two SQS queues; SNS deferred until >2 consumers.
SUPERSEDED (superseded by ADR-020 (one dispute ever)). Re-dispute allowed only after WITHDRAWN, never after RESOLVED_* (prevents double refund, PR-01 F1). Closes Q-07.
Lambda→service calls via internal ALB because Lambdas cannot join ECS Service Connect; task-to-task stays on Service Connect (PR-01 F3).
/validate requires the caller service token (scope auth/validate); no network-only exception (PR-01 F4).
SUPERSEDED (superseded by ADR-016). Auto-decide runs inside disputes on the locked current row; Lambda only triggers (PR-01 F2).
moto server replaces LocalStack locally (LocalStack now requires licence; verify-claims-01). Confirmed by owner.
No auto-accept/auto-reject: Lambda only moves SUBMITTED→UNDER_REVIEW; only human AGENT resolves (owner). Removes threshold, cap, DUPLICATE auto-match and /internal/transactions.
POC POPIA retention: 1 year after terminal state erase dispute PII text fields and evidence objects; rows kept (owner).
Add GET /dispute/{transactionId} for customer status view (owner approved; new task P-03).
API shaped by owner UI flow: /me (accounts→cards) → /transactions?accountId|cardId → dispute → /disputes list + /dispute/{txnId} timeline.
One dispute per transaction ever (WITHDRAWN counts); expired card blocks a dispute, BLOCKED/CANCELLED do not. Supersedes ADR-011 re-dispute rule.

disputable flag computed server-side in transactions with the shared evaluateTransactionEligibility (same function as POST); degrades to UNAVAILABLE. Disputes reads txns via raw internal endpoint so no call loop.

SUPERSEDED (dispute.account_id part superseded by ADR-024). DB review 2026-10-10: dispute.account_id; disputes_retention role with column-scoped UPDATE; evidence ERASED; card expiry derived only (no EXPIRED status); DB CHECKs on amounts/resolution/posted_at/expiry; closed history action list; insert-only history has no updated_at; FKs ON DELETE RESTRICT.

Drop idempotency_key, outbox, processed_event, notification_cursor (owner: overkill). unique(transaction_id) is the retry guard; events published after commit best-effort; DB is source of truth; consumers idempotent by design.

No partial disputes: full txn amount always. Dispute stores only transaction_id + its own data; txn details read live from transactions (batch internal endpoint). GET /disputes loses account/card filters.
GET /disputes keeps accountId/cardId filters, resolved through transactions' internal batch lookup (dispute stores only transaction_id). Partially reverses ADR-024's filter removal.

No /internal path prefix and no trusted x-* header. Each service runs a public port (8080, ALB, user principals only) and a service port (8081, Service Connect/internal ALB, service principals + scope only). Same paths may exist on both with different handlers; the token is always validated.

SUPERSEDED by ADR-028. POST /dispute/{transactionId} is multipart/form-data with optional 0–5 evidence files (PDF/JPEG/PNG by magic bytes, ≤10 MB each), streamed by disputes to S3. Removes presigned URLs, S3 events, evidence-intake Lambda and the service-port evidence endpoint; evidence status STORED|ERASED.

Evidence via presigned PUT to a quarantine bucket (signed type/length/sha256) → malware scan → evidence-intake Lambda promotes clean files to the evidence bucket. The disputes service never handles file bytes (PCI scope, untrusted-file isolation, mobile). Supersedes ADR-027. POST /dispute is JSON with optional file declarations.

Monorepo: backend/ (Node 24; one folder per service: backend/auth, backend/users, backend/transactions, backend/disputes; backend/lambdas/*; backend/packages/*), frontend/ (React+Vite), infra/ (Terraform). Services import only backend/packages; frontend only depends on docs/openapi.
Everything containerised: services, migrations, frontend (nginx), Lambdas as container images (owner). ARM64, non-root, tag = git SHA, Trivy + SBOM.
SUPERSEDED in part by ADR-036 (routing). React + Vite SPA as an ECS container behind the same ALB; host-based routing app./api. to avoid route collisions; CORS limited to app origin.
GitHub Actions, one pipeline per deployable via reusable _build/_deploy; OIDC per-pipeline roles; manual approval (GitHub Environment) on every deploy (owner); Terraform ignores image versions.
No auto-review Lambda (owner, Q-14). New disputes stay SUBMITTED until a human agent picks them from GET :8081/review-queue; review and resolution are AGENT-only. Single SQS queue (notifications).
Owner confirmed (Q-01): 120-day window from posted_at and 7 reason codes. Mock data currency ZAR (Q-09).
REINSTATED by ADR-046. SES sender for dev = dimakatsomm@icloud.com (owner, Q-10); move to noreply@<owner domain> with DKIM before real users (DMARC alignment risk).

SUPERSEDED in part by ADR-037 (domain, HTTPS origin; /api routing kept). No custom domain (owner: POC). CloudFront default https://<id>.cloudfront.net in front; /api/* → ALB (prefix stripped by CloudFront Function), /* → web; same origin, no CORS; WAF on CloudFront; Cognito prefix domain. ALB internal via CloudFront VPC origin if available in af-south-1 (V-06), else public ALB with origin lock. Supersedes host-based app./api. routing of ADR-031.

SUPERSEDED by ADR-046 (domain dropped). Use <owner subdomain> (owner's <owner domain>, Route 53) via a delegated sub-zone: CloudFront on the domain, HTTPS to ALB via origin.<owner subdomain>, optional Cognito custom domain auth.<owner subdomain>, SES domain identity with DKIM/SPF/DMARC sending from noreply@<owner subdomain> (Reply-To dimakatsomm@icloud.com). Supersedes ADR-036's no-domain parts and ADR-035's sender.

Functional architecture across TypeScript (owner): functional core / imperative shell, no classes, immutable data, discriminated unions, Result values for expected failures, injected deps via factory functions, React function components. Lint-enforced (docs/10). (renumbered from a duplicate ADR-036)

Back-office implementation deferred (owner 2026-10-19: client-facing first). Review queue/review/resolution stay in the OpenAPI contract, not built in M1–M4; seed data supplies later-state disputes for UI testing.

Test discipline (owner): only useful tests — one per acceptance criterion and real risk; table-driven core; auth negatives proven once, not per endpoint; no coverage-% targets, snapshots or framework-behaviour tests. Reviewers reject padding as well as gaps.

Repository is PUBLIC on GitHub Free (owner) so environment required reviewers keep manual approval on every deploy. Hardening: secret scanning + push protection, no pull_request_target with PR checkout, fork PRs get no secrets, OIDC roles pinned to main/environment dev, SHA-pinned actions, branch protection on main.

verify-claims-02 applied: presigned PUT signs checksum via unhoistableHeaders + Content-Type/Length via signableHeaders; GuardDuty S3 malware scanning available in af-south-1 (EventBridge result, promote only on NO_THREATS_FOUND, tag-based deny-read); Lambda images on public.ecr.aws/lambda/nodejs:24 built with --provenance=false; TypeScript pinned 6.0.x.
Environment name is `dev` (not poc) — Terraform envs/dev, GitHub Environment `dev`, OIDC sub environment:dev (owner).
Drop the POC label from project descriptions (owner); justifications reworded to dev environment / first release.
Minimal comments in code (owner): only a one-line non-obvious why; no restating, banners, commented-out code or internal JSDoc. Reviewer finding if violated.

No custom domain (owner 2026-10-19: forget <owner domain>, removed from docs). CloudFront default *.cloudfront.net with same-origin /api; ALB via CloudFront VPC origin (fallback CloudFront-only HTTP origin, mock data only); Cognito prefix domain; SES email identity dimakatsomm@icloud.com (sandbox).

Migrations use a minimal custom SQL runner in @cd/db (NNN_name.sql, per-schema schema_migrations, one transaction + pg_advisory_xact_lock per file, set local search_path) instead of node-pg-migrate, which is built around JS migrations and its own tracking table (S-03).
Git history rewritten before first push (owner: scrub) to remove the dropped domain; old objects purged. Commit ids changed from 77adafb.. to 2e6220f..
Owner GitHub handle @dimakatsomm: CODEOWNERS owner and required reviewer on GitHub Environment dev.

POST /dispute/{id}/evidence is retry-safe: a declaration matching an existing PENDING item (sha256+size+type) re-signs that evidenceId instead of creating a new slot (from W-03). Implemented in P-05 (M2).
Frontend API types generated without --immutable: openapi-typescript-helpers Readable<T> mangles readonly arrays, forcing casts in every screen (W-02/W-04).

Service images use `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod --filter @cd/<svc>...` not `pnpm deploy`: workspace packages export raw .ts and Node refuses type stripping under node_modules (found in U-01).
Standard service env names: PUBLIC_PORT, SERVICE_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, DATABASE_URL, DB_POOL_MAX, MIGRATOR_DATABASE_URL, AUTH_URL, TOKEN_URL, SERVICE_CLIENT_ID, SERVICE_CLIENT_SECRET (from U-01).

P-01 rulings: one notifications queue only; one service token per callee (scope isolation); publish right after commit, before signing, awaited with retries inside a 1.5 s budget (SQS client 1 s timeouts, SDK retries off); signing failure after commit → 503 UPLOAD_SIGNING_UNAVAILABLE (dispute stays created), recover by re-declaring via /evidence; file_name rejects control chars ≤255; circuit breaker deferred to M4. Each upstream call (token + request + retry) has one 2 s overall deadline.

M2 rulings (owner): quarantine key intake/{transactionId}/{evidenceId}; disputes decides STORED/REJECTED from declared-vs-detected facts and returns the evidence-bucket key; intake promotes only on STORED. Notifier checks current dispute version (svc-notifier gets disputes/read; service lookup returns version) and skips stale status emails; evidence emails always send. Retention also erases evidence file_name. Lambdas read secrets via @aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager. GuardDuty fallback = metric+log only, flag off by default. P-06 folded into P-01/P-05b.

Backend HTTP boundary schemas are generated as zod from docs/openapi (owner chose generation over a contract test). Constraints that hand-written zod carried move into the specs. Raw parameterised SQL stays; no ORM (owner).

Generator: @hey-api/openapi-ts 0.99.0 (zod plugin only, exact pin, devDependency of backend/packages/contracts), custom resolvers: additionalProperties:false -> z.strictObject, format uuid -> z.guid(), date-time with offset. pnpm override js-yaml 5.5.0 (advisories in 0.99.0 pin). Layout: @cd/contracts/<spec> exports; services import own specs + callee *.service only (lint-enforced). Handlers parse with generated schemas (no Fastify type provider); queryOf helper coerces query strings. Spec policy: oneOf with $ref members + const discriminators; no allOf on strict schemas; *.service responses tolerant (no additionalProperties:false); bad reasonCode/description on create = 400 (was 422), 422 only for eligibility. Contract tests: integration responses safeParse against generated response schemas. Fallback: orval 8.40.0.

Generated header schemas are not used for If-Match: disputes checks If-Match by hand, as today: missing → 428 before body validation; malformed or stale → 412 after the body parses; the spec keeps required+pattern for documentation. Non-uuid userId on users contact path becomes 400 per spec. Residual cross-field rules (from<to, min<=max, EDIT changes >=1 field, cursor decode, calendar validity) stay as .refine in the service, predicates in dispute-domain where they are domain rules.

V-10: user token on a service port (8081) → 403 is proven in unit/integration tests only; E-02a adds the compose-network check.
M2-00: disputes.service lookup response adds version (done in the spec; P-05b implements it); LOOKUP_MAX_IDS=100 in disputes transactions-client duplicates the transactions.service limit.

R-12 (D-06 gate, low): the [erased] tombstones are only unforgeable via API validation (description min 10); an app-side write of [erased] would make the sweeper skip a row. Consider an erased_at column in a later migration. Index builds run inside the migration transaction (no CONCURRENTLY) — fine for dev; plan out-of-band builds before large tables.
P-05x follow-up: move the evidence cap-counting statuses (PENDING+STORED) and the ADR-050 declaration-matching rule from disputes core into @cd/dispute-domain (rule 2).
L-07: pin public.ecr.aws/lambda/nodejs:24 by digest (or dated tag) and set --platform=linux/arm64 consistently in all three Lambda Dockerfiles; confirm RIE runs as USER 65534 in evidence-intake.

M3 infra (from L-03 gate): default event bus must reject aws.-prefixed PutEvents; intake Lambda resource policy allows only events.amazonaws.com with the rule SourceArn; quarantine bucket policy denies GetObject unless tagged NO_THREATS_FOUND and must not exempt the intake role; client secret stored as raw string.
auth-client: service-token fetch has no timeout of its own; a hung token endpoint pins the in-flight promise in a warm container. Add a per-fetch timeout (follow-up task).
